name: single-binary
body: Delivered as one self-contained static `eypres` binary (Go), built for exactly these supported targets: darwin/arm64, darwin/amd64, windows/amd64, windows/arm64. No runtime, network access or install step needed. The binary packages the whole tool (authoring/scaffolding, templating, validation, presentation). AC: `eypres init && eypres start` works offline on a clean machine for each of the four targets.
